note: Die laute Saatkrähen-Kolonie und das Rothund-Rudel gibt es nur in der Rookery. Allein wirst du laut Profil still und zurückhaltend, folgst Herden oder Apex-Räubern und bedienst dich an Rissen. Das ist der Kolkrabe, der Wölfen folgt, gern auch einem Achillobator.

analogs.covers: Solo life: a quiet, watchful loner that follows big hunters and herds and scavenges from their kills
Heart: a colony bird by nature that misses its rookery and keeps its curiosity

solo.headline: A lone raven in the night: quiet and watchful, it trails herds and Apex hunters for scraps, hunts small prey alone and finds comfort in an Achillobator companion.

setting.label: Forests and wetlands, behind herds and Apex hunters
setting.note: A loner roams forests and wetlands, trailing herbivore herds or tolerant Apex carnivores.

solo.playsLike: Alone you can get by for long stretches, but you become quieter and more reserved, singing and chattering far less than in a rookery. You often trail herbivore herds or Apex carnivores that tolerate you, scavenge from kills when permitted and patiently watch your surroundings. You hunt alone up to Medium tier, mostly small prey and critters. An Achillobator companion keeps loneliness away, and lonely Latenivenatrix seek one out themselves when they can't find their way back to their rookery. You hunt at night and still flee Hatzegopteryx, Quetzalcoatlus and Kelenken.

why.text: “Solo individuals become quieter and more reserved, and show less communicative chatter or singing as opposed to those within a rookery.” A raven is far quieter than a rook colony.
Solitary Latenivenatrix “often trail behind herbivore herds or Apex carnivores that tolerate them” and scavenge from kills when permitted, as ravens follow wolves.
“Achillobator companions help to stave away feelings of loneliness”, and loners may seek one out themselves. The raven-and-wolf partnership in miniature.
Orphans grow into capable solitary hunters of small prey and critters, as ravens also kill small animals.

notLike: Ravens are mostly active by day; Latenivenatrix hunts at night.
Ravens are content as a pair; Latenivenatrix is social by nature and does best with a companion.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein Kolkrabe in der Nacht. Allein kommst du lange zurecht, wirst aber still und zurückhaltend und singst und plauderst viel weniger als in der Rookery. Du folgst Pflanzenfresser-Herden oder Apex-Räubern, die dich dulden, bedienst dich an ihren Rissen, wenn sie dich lassen, und beobachtest geduldig deine Umgebung. Allein jagst du bis Medium, meist kleine Beute und Kleintiere. Am besten geht es dir mit einem Achillobator als Gefährten, und findest du nicht zurück zur Rookery, suchst du dir selbst einen. Vor Hatzegopteryx, Quetzalcoatlus und Kelenken fliehst du weiter.
